summary: This is a Makefile that orchestrates a Docker-based Joomla development environment. It provides commands to start, stop, and manage the application, along with a detailed startup message that displays all the configuration details like ports, database credentials, and admin information pulled from environment variables.

explanations.1: This includes a .env file if it exists, allowing you to define environment variables that the Makefile will use throughout its commands.
explanations.4: The $$ is Makefile syntax to produce a single $ in the output; this line runs the docker compose config command while injecting the current user and group IDs as environment variables so Docker containers run with matching permissions.
explanations.7: The leading dash suppresses errors if the command fails, and the @ symbol prevents the command itself from being printed to the terminal before it runs.
explanations.13: This removes the Docker volume directories (db_data and joomla_data) to completely wipe the database and application data, giving you a fresh start.
explanations.17: The ANSI escape codes (\033[...m) are terminal color codes that make the text yellow and bold; this prints a message with a URL to access the website.
explanations.52: This creates the two directories where Docker will store persistent data, using -p to avoid errors if they already exist.
